notes.title: not just free! we will also update new content for free!
notes.notes:
I don't understand why everyone is talking about "Paranormal Campus" stabbing players in the back, as if this free offering is doomed to bring more bad than good for old players. Twenty months ago, "Paranormal Campus" embarked on its journey from Steam and started its first internal test, and the game content was then unified. Wherever this game went, players welcomed it wholeheartedly. It could really be said to have had all the favorable conditions, and that vibrant scene where everything thrived seemed still in front of our eyes. Just twenty months later, has it come to this that it has become the burial ground for "Paranormal Campus"?
Anyway, for this event, it's free access plus free content updates. The advantage is on our side!

notes.title: “Mysterious School”Will Be Transformed into a Free Game
notes.notes:
Dear players:
Hello everyone!
First of all, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to each and every one of you for your support and love for the game "Haunted Schoolyard". It was your enthusiasm that made this game have a wonderful and lively time in the past.
However, recently we have to face a practical situation. That is, the number of players in the game has been gradually decreasing. This has directly led to a huge difficulty for those players who have purchased the game when it comes to matching teammates to play the game. Most of the time, it's hard to gather enough people to start a pleasant gaming experience, which goes against our original intention of hoping everyone can have a great time playing in the game.
To improve this situation and enable more players to easily join the game and enjoy the fun of "Haunted Schoolyard" together with others, after careful consideration, we have decided to make a significant adjustment: One week after this announcement is issued, we will turn the game "Haunted Schoolyard" into a free game.
Here, we would like to specifically remind all players that within the next week, please refrain from purchasing the game to avoid any unnecessary losses.
At the same time, we are fully aware that for those players who have already purchased the game, you have shown your sincere dedication and enthusiasm towards the game and have actually paid for it. Originally, we also hoped to offer you some corresponding compensations. However, currently we are facing a rather thorny situation. After the game was successfully launched on the market, all members of our original development team have left for various reasons. Now they are scattered all over the country to work, and it's extremely difficult to regroup them to update the game or carry out other related work. Nevertheless, please rest assured that we have not forgotten the efforts of those players who have purchased the game. In the following period, we will do our best to come up with some feasible solutions and strive to provide you with some compensations to express our sincere gratitude for your continuous support.
Finally, once again, thank you to every player for your support of "Haunted Schoolyard". We hope that after the game becomes free, more players will join in, making our "Haunted Schoolyard" lively again and enabling everyone to have a pleasant experience in the game!
The Operation Team of "Haunted Schoolyard"
November 12th, 2024

notes.title: 重大更新，大幅度提升游戏体验
notes.notes:
整体

1.加入道具 回魂符 
功能：全体阵亡后，弹出一段文字   队友已全部阵亡，按R使用回魂符。倒计时30秒，完了后退出游戏。
获取方式：简单难度开局就三张，在背包里面显示  地图里面刷三张
                   普通两张 地图刷一张
                   最高难度无
2.加入道具 聚宝箱
功能：一把游戏结束后，弹出一个提示  你已获得聚宝箱可以在下一局使用。存档
在准备界面加入一个 使用聚宝箱的按钮 只有房主有聚宝箱才能点。其他人也显示这个按钮，点击后提示“只有房主能使用”
如果有人使用则在挖出棺材后，棺材旁边就会多一个聚宝箱。
聚宝箱分为铜 银 金 铜箱可以开10次 银 20次 金 30次
开的方式：和聚宝箱互动播放声音特效后，在聚宝箱面前出现道具。
获取方式：一阶段内失败获得铜箱
                 二 三阶段失败获得银箱
                 四五阶段金箱
3.小鬼调整
简单难度小鬼攻击不再减速
普通难度被小鬼攻击减速少一半
4.摄像机电量增加，举起摄像机不再消耗电量。
5.增加新手引导
6.难度系统调整，使现在不同的难度差别更明显。
7.修复BUG

notes.title: 上线第一天的更新说明。感谢大家的支持！！！
